dct_title_s: Counties with Demographics, New York State, 2000
dct_description_sm: New York State counties with census demographics. Converted mechanically from CUGIR's GeoBlacklight 1.0 record (cugir-007865) to Aardvark so the viewer will load it. Its FGDC Entity and Attribute section defines 68 of 82 fields - the densest attribute documentation found anywhere in OpenGeoMetadata that also fetches with CORS.
